description: This Java source file defines the StorageServiceCondition class, which implements the Condition interface and enables conditional configuration of a storage service based on the 'storage.type' property. It provides logic to determine whether the specified storage type matches the application's configuration.

classes.name: StorageServiceCondition
classes.description: Implements Conditional logic to enable storage service based on the 'storage.type' property, defaulting to 'local' if unspecified.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines if the storage type configured matches the specified qualifier value, logging the selected type if it does.
